rule_text: IF at 'register submission date request' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'close case'
IF at 'close case' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'creating environmental permit decision'
IF at 'creating environmental permit decision' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'creating cover letter decision'
IF at 'creating cover letter decision' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'continuation term to decision'
IF at 'continuation term to decision' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'enter senddate continuation'
IF at 'enter senddate continuation' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'send confirmation receipt'
IF at 'send confirmation receipt' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'close case'
IF at 'close case' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'request to competent authority'
IF at 'request to competent authority' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'create forwarding copy'
IF at 'create forwarding copy' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'enter senddate letter to stakeholders'
IF at 'enter senddate letter to stakeholders' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'forward transcript to stakeholders'
IF at 'forward transcript to stakeholders' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'phase forwarded to competent authority'
IF at 'phase forwarded to competent authority' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'enter senddate letter to stakeholders'
IF at 'enter senddate letter to stakeholders' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'phase application received'
IF at 'phase application received' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'phase decision sent'
IF at 'phase decision sent' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'send design decision to stakeholders'
IF at 'send design decision to stakeholders' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'start WABOprocedure'
IF at 'start WABOprocedure' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'completed subcases content'
IF at 'completed subcases content' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'terminate on request'
IF at 'terminate on request' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'inform BAG administrator'
IF at 'inform BAG administrator' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'resume completeness subcases'
IF at 'resume completeness subcases' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'register objection and appeal periods'
IF at 'register objection and appeal periods' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'submit decision'
IF at 'submit decision' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'phase decision ready'
IF at 'phase decision ready' AND low delay AND moderate rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'phase updated plan received'
